{{Current events|year=2018|month=03|day=26|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Turkish military operation in Afrin]]
**[[Turkish Free Syrian Army|Turkish forces]] claim to have found a [[mass grave]] containing the remains of 59 of their fighters in Kucuk Meydan, [[Afrin, Syria]]. [https://aa.com.tr/en/middle-east/mass-grave-of-fsa-members-discovered-in-afrin/1099057 (Anadolu Agency)]

;Business and economy
*[[Economy of the United States]]
**U.S. firearms and ammunition manufacturer [[Remington Arms]] files for [[Chapter 11, Title 11, United States Code|chapter 11 bankruptcy]] protection after amassing [[US$]]950 million worth of debt. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2018-03-26/cerberus-s-remington-gunmaker-seeks-bankruptcy-shield-from-debts (Bloomberg)]
**Following a collapse of a [[fish farm|farm]] and a large release of [[Atlantic salmon]] into the [[Pacific]], the state of [[Washington (state)|Washington]] bans the farming of Atlantic salmon in their territorial waters. [https://www.npr.org/sections/thesalt/2018/03/26/597019406/after-three-decades-washington-state-bans-atlantic-salmon-farms (NPR)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2018 Kemerovo fire]]
**Witnesses and [[Russia]]'s Investigative Committee say the [[Winter Cherry complex]]'s exits were blocked and there were no alarms during the disaster. [http://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-43543105 (BBC)]
*[[US-Bangla Airlines Flight 211]]
**The death toll rises to 52 people as a survivor dies in hospital. [https://www.khaleejtimes.com/international/rest-of-asia/us-bangla-plane-crash-survivor-shaheen-dies (''Khaleej Times'')]

;International relations
*[[Poisoning of Sergei and Yulia Skripal]]
**[[Canada–Russia relations]]
***[[Canada]] expels four [[Russian]] diplomats citing solidarity with the [[United Kingdom]] following the attempted murder of a former [[Russia]]n spy in the [[United Kingdom]] by a [[nerve agent]]. [https://www.canada.ca/en/global-affairs/news/2018/03/canada-expels-russian-diplomats-in-solidarity-with-united-kingdom.html (Global Affairs Canada)]
**[[Russia–United States relations]]
***[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] orders the closure of a Russian consulate in [[Seattle]], [[Washington (state)|Washington]], and the expulsion of 60 Russian officials. [https://www.npr.org/sections/thetwo-way/2018/03/26/596966272/us-expels-dozens-of-russian-diplomats-closes-consulate-in-seattle (NPR)]
**[[Russia–European Union relations]]
***[[Donald Tusk]] announces [[European Union]] nations have asked 30 Russian diplomats to leave. [[Germany]], [[France]], and [[Poland]] are among the EU nations to expel diplomats with other European countries including the [[Ukraine]] and [[Albania]] doing the same. [http://www.itv.com/news/2018-03-26/us-and-14-eu-nations-to-expel-russian-diplomats-over-sergei-skripal-poisoning/ (ITV)]

;Law and crime
*[[French]] police detain two men in connection with the murder of an 85-year [[The Holocaust|Holocaust survivor]] who was found in the burned remains of her apartment. The prosecutor's office is investigating if the killing was "motivated by the real or supposed [[anti-semitism|adherence to a religion]]". [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-france-crime/french-police-investigate-possible-anti-semitic-killing-in-paris-idUSKBN1H22CN (Reuters)]
*[[Carbanak]]
**[[Spanish]] police in [[Alicante]] arrest the suspected leader of a bank [[hack]]ing scheme believed to have stolen over [[Euro sign|€]]1 billion. [https://www.rferl.org/a/spain-captures-bank-hack-mastermind-1-2-billion/29124973.html (Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Egyptian presidential election, 2018]]
**The [[Egyptian]] electorate vote in their presidential election, with incumbent President [[Abdel-Fattah el-Sissi]] facing only one opponent. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/middle_east/in-egypts-election-turnout-provides-the-only-suspense/2018/03/26/f29ee6f8-30b5-11e8-b6bd-0084a1666987_story.html (''The Washington Post'')]

;Science and technology
*[[Discoveries of exoplanets]]
**ArXiv publishes research that a [[gas giant]] may be orbiting a [[brown dwarf]]. The [[exoplanet]], designated OGLE-2017-BLG-1522Lb, orbits its host at a distance of 0.59 [[Astronomical unit|AU]] and could be the first known gas giant to have formed inside the [[protoplanetary disk]] of a brown dwarf. [https://phys.org/news/2018-03-astronomers-giant-planet-orbiting-brown.html (Phys.org)]

;Sports
*[[2018 NCAA Division I Men's Basketball Tournament]]
**[[2017–18 Loyola Ramblers men's basketball team|Loyola-Chicago]], a surprise 11th seed that will play in the tournament semifinals (the [[NCAA Division I Men's Basketball Tournament#Final Four|Final Four]]), is [[license#Trademark and brand licensing|licensing]] the  name and image of the team's chaplain, 98-year-old [[Sister Jean|Sister Jean Dolores Schmidt]], on school merchandise with her blessing. The so-called "Media darling" didn't ask for anything for herself," the athletic department says. [http://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/22914293/sister-jean-gave-blessing-loyola-chicago-license-name-image (ESPN)]  [https://www.nytimes.com/2018/03/22/sports/loyola-chicago-sister-jean-ncaa-tournament.html (''The New York Times'')]
